There are several issues here:

1. The mesh that is provided to the soft body has unused vertices. The index array only uses the first 87 vertices, but there are 211 vertices in total. The godot jolt module discards these extra vertices but wasn't properly checking for discarded vertices when rendering the mesh. I've created a PR that fixes this issue.
2. The soft bodies have been scaled at node level. This is currently not supported in the jolt module, so the ears appear much too big. To fix this you need to scale your mesh and remove the scaling from the SoftBody3D node. Alternatively, scale support should be added to the jolt module.
